name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Holds.of_pres
typeText:
∀ {α : Type} {rep : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Rep α},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.GoodRep rep →
    ∀ {T : Nat} {a : α} {lo : Nat} {m m' : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem},
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Holds rep T a lo m →
        ∀ {W : List.{0} Nat},
          DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Pres m m' (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP)
              (List.cons.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP W) →
            LE.le.{0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) (m' DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP) →
              (∀ (x : Nat), Membership.mem.{0, 0} W x → LT.lt.{0} x DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN) →
                T ∉ W →
                  LT.lt.{0} T DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN →
                    Ne.{1} T DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP → DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Holds rep T a lo m'

source.code:
theorem Holds.of_pres {α : Type} {rep : Rep α} (hr : GoodRep rep) {T : ℕ} {a : α} {lo : ℕ}
    {m m' : Mem} (h : Holds rep T a lo m) {W : List ℕ} (hp : Pres m m' (m HP) (HP :: W))
    (hhp : m HP ≤ m' HP) (hW : ∀ x, x ∈ W → x < IN) (hT : T ∉ W) (hTIN : T < IN) (hT0 : T ≠ HP) :
    Holds rep T a lo m' := by
  obtain ⟨hlo, hi, h1, h2, h3⟩ := h
  refine ⟨hlo, hi, h1, le_trans h2 hhp, ?_⟩
  rw [hp T (by omega) (by simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or]; exact ⟨hT0, hT⟩)]
  exact hr.frame m m' lo hi _ _ h3 (fun x hx1 hx2 => hp x (by omega) (by
    simp only [List.mem_cons, not_or]
    exact ⟨by unfold HP IN at *; omega, fun hxW => by have := hW x hxW; omega⟩))
